recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-22779 unless a future work group decision changes Communication.topic or its search semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-22779 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested adding topic to the Communication search parameters so Communications can be searched by topic, such as lab-result-related communications.
initial_application: The Jira comment links GH commit 69c164b, and git history confirms 69c164bd80725d480a4064903218d3a49093a0fd added a topic/token/Communication.topic row to the former source/communication/communication-spreadsheet.xml source. The 2021 new-build source rework in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried Communication search parameters into source/communication/bundle-Communication-search-params.xml.
additional_context: Communication is active in source/fhir.ini, so the source/communication search-parameter bundle is in current build scope. Current source defines Communication.topic as a CodeableConcept and defines SearchParameter Communication-topic with code topic, type token, and expression Communication.topic. The originating Zulip thread and Patient Care minutes align with the Jira request, and bounded community searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because the current source already implements the requested search parameter against the existing Communication.topic element.
